resources.string: Either the su binary could not be found or you did not allow root permission for AdAway.\n\nThis can happen when your device is not rooted. You can find information about how to root your device on wiki.lineageos.org or other Android websites.
Protection is off. To try again, choose VPN Mode and approve the Android connection request.
AdAway detected that another VPN has the "Always-on VPN" setting active.\n\nThis prevents AdAway from requesting VPN access. Please disable "Always-on VPN" on the correspondent VPN and try again.
